authored_scope: Supported: random grid sizes (default 7..22 per side, which is a synthetic extension; explicit 5..30 accepted), 1-3 anchor shapes (crosses, bars, blocks, polyominoes), 2-6 movers on any sides including several on one anchor, movers already on the border (no-op), anchors with no movers, and 0-2 non-touching distractors. Explicit latent scenes reconstruct the fixtures. Deliberately not supported: movers touching 9 from two sides (ambiguous), mover paths blocked by other objects, shared colours among non-9 objects, and background colours other than 7.
authored_constraints: Background is always 7 and anchors are always 9. Non-9 objects use distinct colours from {0,1,2,3,4,5,6,8}.
Anchor shapes are separated by at least two cells (Chebyshev distance > 2).
Each mover touches 9 cells from exactly one side, and its slide direction is opposite that side.
Mover slide sweeps (including final positions) are disjoint from 9 cells, from all other object cells and from other movers' sweeps.
Objects (movers and distractors) are not 8-adjacent to each other initially. Distractors are not 8-adjacent to any 9 and do not lie in any sweep.
At least one mover moves a nonzero distance, so the output differs from the input.
Explicit scenes are validated: in-bounds, non-overlapping, colour not 7/9, direction consistent with touching side, unblocked path; otherwise a ValueError is raised.
Partial explicit parameters (nines without objects, or a scene without width/height) are rejected.
